study type: Cluster randomized study evaluating a simulation-based educational program
exposure: External cephalic version (ECV) simulation-based educational program
cohort: The participants were obstetrics and gynecology house officers, junior residents, senior residents/fellows, and consultants/attendings at Korle Bu Teaching Hospital in Ghana.
finding: The external cephalic version simulation-based program significantly improved comfort, confidence, knowledge, and skill among Ghanaian clinicians.
mod_finding: The program aims to increase external cephalic version rates and thereby decrease rates of avoidable cesarean delivery and its complications.
